dedupe_keys.name: digitransit open source journey planning platform of hsl and fintraffic finland with hsl open data apis

description: Digitransit is the open-source journey planning platform behind Finland's public transport route planners, built on OpenTripPlanner, together with the open APIs that HSL, the Helsinki Regional Transport Authority, offers to developers. It is developed by HSL and Fintraffic (originally with the Finnish Transport Agency) and published through the HSLdevcom developer community on GitHub. Coverage: Finland, with the HSL Reittiopas planner for the Helsinki region, Fintraffic's national planner and further regional deployments. The platform combines routing on OpenTripPlanner with GTFS timetables and real-time data, map tiles, geocoding and a React journey planner user interface; HSL also publishes open data such as city bike trip records per season. In November 2024 a new routing version, API and developer documentation were released. Format and access: source code on GitHub and routing APIs described on digitransit.fi that need an API subscription key; free. Licence (read on 2026-09-29): EUPL-1.2 or AGPL-3.0 (source code); HSL data terms not readable from the cloud. Caveats: the platform is a production system, so self-hosting needs several services, and the developer pages were not readable here. Simulation uses: a reference routing stack and data source for accessibility, network flow and emergency re-routing studies of transit in Finland. Related records: OpenTripPlanner (model-opentripplanner) is the routing engine it builds on, and the GTFS specification (data-gtfs-specification) defines its timetable input.
